profile.description: National Gas Company SAOG engages in marketing and sale of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) in the Sultanate of Oman, other GCC countries, and Asia. The company provides LPG cylinders; bulk LPG for food, ceramic, glass, metal works, and dairy industries, as well as for commercial establishments, such as hotels and resorts; and D Cylinder, an LPG cylinder solution for hotels, and commercial and industrial establishments. It also produces aerosol propellants for the manufacturers of pesticides, air-fresheners, perfumes, cosmetics, spray paints, and food grade packaging materials; synthetic natural gas, which is a blend of LPG and diluents; NC+ cutting gas, a hydrocarbon-based cutting solution; and lubricants, as well as supplies propane, and generates nitrogen and oxygen. In addition, it undertakes turnkey jobs for the design, engineering, and installation of LPG bottling plants, deodorized unit and aerosol filling systems, auto gas refueling stations, pressure reducing and gas metering stations, synthetic natural gas systems, gas powered power systems, and gas refrigeration/air-conditioning systems; and for the design, installation, commissioning, operation, and maintenance of bulk LPG tank installations with related piping and distribution systems. Further, the company offers vaporizers, pumps, regulators, PRS, metering system, secondary pipeline work, gas detectors, firefighting systems, LPG leakage detection systems, LPG valves, etc.; and natural gas pipeline work, and NG PRS and metering systems. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Muscat, the Sultanate of Oman.
